text:
ANTIFRAUD::alert_view_id
Description
This command returns the configured URL and view which triggered this
alert. empty if not a view.
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
alert_view_id
Examples
when
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
{
log
local0.
"Alert View ID: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_view_id]."
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
